explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is non-zero only at D2 when S2 is reached and the previous trial was unrewarded: 9-10 when S2 comes by a rare transition after choosing a1, within one to three trials of the agent trying a2/S2 (often straight after a common S2 trial), and 5-8 when the agent switches from a run of a1 trials to a2 and reaches S2 commonly. It is 0 whenever S1 is reached, 0 to 3 when the previous trial was rewarded or during a settled run of a2/S2 choices, and 0 to 2 for a lone rare S2 in the middle of a long a1 streak.
